samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">7</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF">3</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M1">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M2">4</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M3">6</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M4">5</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M5">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M6">3</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M7">0</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt">Counter to keep track of clock cycles.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div_int">Intermediate divided clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="phase_shift_clk">Phase-shifted clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="phase_shift_clk_delay">Delayed phase-shifted clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="phase_shift_clk_advance">Advanced phase-shifted clock signal.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
                clk_div_int <= 0;
                phase_shift_clk <= 0;
                phase_shift_clk_delay <= 0;
                phase_shift_clk_advance <= 0;
            end else begin
                // Counter logic
                if (cnt == MUL2_DIV_CLK - 1) begin
                    cnt <= 0;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
                
                // Clock division logic
                if (cnt < DIV_CLK_HALF) begin
                    clk_div_int <= ~clk_div_int;
                end
                
                // Phase shifting logic
                case(cnt)
                    DIV_CLK_HALF_M1: phase_shift_clk <= ~clk_div_int;
                    DIV_CLK_HALF_M2: phase_shift_clk_delay <= ~clk_div_int;
                    DIV_CLK_HALF_M3: phase_shift_clk_advance <= ~clk_div_int;
                    default: ;
                endcase
            end
        </endalways_comb>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Double edge clocking technique to divide the input clock by 3.5x. Generate two uneven clock periods: one with 4 source clock cycles and another with 3 source clock cycles. In the next cycle, generate phase-shifted versions of the divided clock. One phase is delayed by half a clock period, and the other is advanced by half a clock period. Finally, logically OR the two intermediate clocks to produce the final fractional divided clock output.</implementation>
</module>
